title: Ideal
body: Does one thing perfectly. Great for the busy, absent minded or avoidant! The regular upgrades add features that are genuinely useful without disturbing the simple, intuitive interface. And that's harder than it sounds – introducing sensible enhancements and a cleaner interface without compromising the functionality. I’ve been using it since it first appeared, and the regular updates are it gets better app the time.
author: RonanMC

title: Honestly the best app on my phone
body: It has honestly made my life better. It is simple, intuitive and prevents me forgetting tasks - both incidental and incredibly important. If you’re absent minded, this app is an absolute must have.

title: A lifesaver
body:
As someone with ADHD, this is the reminder app I wish I’d had all my life. A simple but perfectly curated feature set, and an an absolute masterclass in UI design. Properly used, it gives one the power to stay on top of their responsibilities without losing focus. 

This is truly the most important app on my phone.

title: iOS 7 inspired UI is no upgrade
body:
Long, long time user of Due's original version. Light, simple and quick means to set up reminders, but the new UI changes make this process a lot more cluttered. Setting a reminder brings you to a screen with 20 different clickable buttons, a far cry from the easy to use first edition.

I've also had problems with some notifications not being pushed/ not making sounds, despite not being on silent? Could be an issue with my own notifications can't confirm. 

Loved the app before, but would like to see if strip back and simplify some more. I'll be using alternatives until then.
